parameters.content:
## Grafica para el 01 (sin Trigger Telegram)
Lo llama la tool enviar_grafica. SQL → Chart.js → POST QuickChart → sendPhoto.

1. Importa y mapea Postgres + Telegram.
2. Publica/activa este flujo.
3. En el 01, tool enviar_grafica: elige este workflow y refresca inputs.
4. Config.quickchartUrl: interno `http://quickchart:80/chart` o publico `https://demo-quickchart.hiti0l.easypanel.host/chart`.
5. chat.id lo manda el 01.
6. tipo: embudo_mes | reservas_dia | reservas_origen.
7. estilo: barras | pie | lineas (pie no aplica por dia; lineas solo por dia).
8. periodo YYYY-MM.

No pongas nombres ni telefonos en la grafica.

parameters.query:
WITH periodo AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $1::text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN ($1::text || '-01')::date
    ELSE (timezone('America/Caracas', now()))::date
  END AS d
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    (date_trunc('month', d)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas') AS start_at,
    ((date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas') AS end_at,
    date_trunc('month', d)::date AS start_day,
    (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month')::date AS end_day
  FROM periodo
),
first_touch AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE NOT from_me
  GROUP BY lead_id
),
cierres AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(created_at) AS occurred_at
  FROM lead_score_events
  WHERE stage = 'concreto'
  GROUP BY lead_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT lead_id, occurred_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE from_me
    AND (
      (content_type = 'document' AND body ILIKE '%certificado%')
      OR body ILIKE '%certificado de reserva%'
    )
),
days AS (
  SELECT generate_series(start_day, end_day - 1, interval '1 day')::date AS dia
  FROM bounds
)
SELECT
  to_char(d.dia, 'DD/MM') AS label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l_ft.id)::int AS conversaciones,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.lead_id)::int AS reservaron,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.lead_id) FILTER (
    WHERE ft_c.first_at >= b.start_at AND ft_c.first_at < b.end_at
  )::int AS reservaron_nuevos,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.lead_id) FILTER (
    WHERE ft_c.first_at < b.start_at
  )::int AS reservaron_recurrentes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l_ft.id) FILTER (WHERE l_ft.stage = 'pregunto_no_concreto')::int AS preguntaron_sin_cerrar
FROM days d
CROSS JOIN bounds b
LEFT JOIN first_touch f
  ON (f.first_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas')::date = d.dia
LEFT JOIN leads l_ft ON l_ft.id = f.lead_id
LEFT JOIN cierres c
  ON (c.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas')::date = d.dia
LEFT JOIN first_touch ft_c ON ft_c.lead_id = c.lead_id
GROUP BY d.dia
ORDER BY d.dia;

WITH periodo AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $1::text ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN ($1::text || '-01')::date
    ELSE (timezone('America/Caracas', now()))::date
  END AS d
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', d)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas' AS start_at,
    (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Caracas' AS end_at
  FROM periodo
),
first_touch AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE NOT from_me
  GROUP BY lead_id
),
cierres AS (
  SELECT lead_id, MIN(created_at) AS occurred_at
  FROM lead_score_events
  WHERE stage = 'concreto'
  GROUP BY lead_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT lead_id, occurred_at
  FROM whatsapp_messages
  WHERE from_me
    AND (
      (content_type = 'document' AND body ILIKE '%certificado%')
      OR body ILIKE '%certificado de reserva%'
    )
),
cierres_mes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.lead_id
  FROM cierres c
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE c.occurred_at >= b.start_at AND c.occurred_at < b.end_at
),
cohorte AS (
  SELECT l.id, l.stage
  FROM first_touch f
  JOIN leads l ON l.id = f.lead_id
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE f.first_at >= b.start_at AND f.first_at < b.end_at
)
SELECT
  to_char(timezone('America/Caracas', b.start_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS periodo,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.id)::int AS conversaciones,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.lead_id)::int AS reservaron,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.lead_id) FILTER (
    WHERE ft.first_at >= b.start_at AND ft.first_at < b.end_at
  )::int AS reservaron_nuevos,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.lead_id) FILTER (
    WHERE ft.first_at < b.start_at
  )::int AS reservaron_recurrentes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.id) FILTER (WHERE co.stage = 'pregunto_no_concreto')::int AS preguntaron_sin_cerrar,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.id) FILTER (WHERE co.stage = 'no_respondio')::int AS no_respondieron,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.id) FILTER (WHERE co.stage = 'en_proceso')::int AS en_proceso,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT cm.lead_id) FILTER (
      WHERE ft.first_at >= b.start_at AND ft.first_at < b.end_at
    ) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT co.id), 0),
    1
  ) AS pct_reservaciones
FROM bounds b
LEFT JOIN cohorte co ON true
LEFT JOIN cierres_mes cm ON true
LEFT JOIN first_touch ft ON ft.lead_id = cm.lead_id
GROUP BY b.start_at;
